surface.name: Storefront
surface.body: The customer-facing app: home, category pages, product detail, cart, checkout. Single-page React app under `src/storefront/`. Regions named below correspond to how the design team talks about the surface in reviews — they precede the component breakdown.

region.name: Top navigation bar
region.role: Brand mark, category links, account dropdown, cart-count badge.

region.name: Product grid
region.role: Responsive grid of product cards on category and search pages.

region.name: Product detail hero
region.role: Image gallery, name, price, variant selector, add-to-cart button — the page above the fold on a product page.

region.name: Size guide drawer
region.role: Slide-in drawer linked from the variant selector; shows the apparel size chart.

region.name: Cart drawer
region.role: Slide-in mini-cart showing current line items and a "go to checkout" CTA.

region.name: Checkout form
region.role: Address, shipping method, payment-method picker. Submits to .
